name: McDonald's World Famous Fries (Small Size)
whyItWorks: Skinless shoestring potatoes fried crisp. While high in fat, sticking strictly to a small size satisfies road-trip cravings without overwhelming gallbladder and small bowel bile reabsorption.
prepOrOrderInstructions: NOTE: In the US, McDonald's fry oil contains "Natural Beef Flavor" made from hydrolyzed wheat and milk derivatives. AVOID during severe milk allergy or active flares; enjoy small portion in remission.
